absent: Locking, concurrency and interrupt context rules for bus operations, core list mutation, mapped core selection and driver callbacks are not shown.
Bodies and error contracts for host operations, chip and board info layouts, device identifier layout and driver private structures are outside these fragments.
Enumeration values for host types other than the PCI comparison and the lifetime of MMIO mappings and IRQ numbers are not shown.
Numeric encodings for JTAG control external enable, JTAG control enable and flash control fall beyond the visible part and cannot be stated.
Programming sequences, timing, retry and recovery for OTP, JTAG, PLL and flash type selection are not shown.
Validation, bounds checking and failure behavior for offsets, counts, widths, core indices and translation selection are not shown.

findings.text: The bcma_device record links a core to its parent bus and carries an identifier plus an embedded generic device with a separate DMA device pointer, an interrupt number, a flag showing whether the generic device was registered, a core index and unit number for repeated cores, a primary 32-bit address with eight alternate 32-bit addresses and a wrapper offset, two mapped I/O pointers for the core and its wrapper, an opaque driver private pointer, and a list node linking all cores on the bus.

The bcma_driver record carries a name string and a table of matching identifiers plus callbacks for probe returning status, removal, suspend and resume with suspend and resume returning status, and shutdown, together with an embedded generic driver object that connects the whole description to driver core infrastructure.

The bcma_bus record holds a pointer to the underlying host device and a base MMIO mapping, a pointer to a host operations table, a host type enumerator with a flag meaningful only for PCI hosts indicating PCIe second generation and a PCI device pointer valid only for PCI hosts, chip and board information records, a pointer to the currently mapped core, a list of cores with a count and a bus number, embedded state for chipcommon including a second variant plus PCI state for two slots plus PCIe2 plus MIPS plus GMAC common state, and a shared SPROM record reused from the SSB subsystem.

The bcma_get_drvdata and bcma_set_drvdata accessors store and retrieve an opaque per-core private pointer for a given core, one returning the stored value and the other replacing it, with no allocation, locking or validation visible.

The bcma_driver_register macro forwards a driver description together with the current module owner to an underlying registration routine, and the module_bcma_driver helper wires that registration macro and the corresponding unregistration routine into module init and exit handling for a named driver instance.

The bcma_read8, bcma_read16, bcma_read32, bcma_write8, bcma_write16, bcma_write32, bcma_aread32, bcma_awrite32, bcma_block_read and bcma_block_write helpers all delegate to the parent bus operations table, with single accesses taking a core and a 16-bit offset and using 32-bit values even for narrow widths, alternate 32-bit accessors providing a second path, and block helpers passing a buffer with a count plus offset and register width through to the bus layer.

The bcma_mask32, bcma_set32, bcma_maskset32, bcma_mask16, bcma_set16 and bcma_maskset16 helpers implement mask by keeping only bits present in the mask, set by adding bits from the set argument, and combined mask then set by first masking and then adding bits, each performed as a separate read followed by a write of the computed value for both 32-bit and 16-bit widths.

The bcma_find_core helper looks up a core by numeric type while defaulting the unit selector to zero, so callers asking only for a type always obtain the first instance while multi-instance selection requires the underlying unit-aware routine.

The bcma_host_pci_up and bcma_host_pci_down helpers do nothing, while bcma_host_pci_irq_ctl reports not supported when the bus host type indicates PCI and otherwise reports success without performing any action.

Core type codes with BCMA_CORE_ prefix use 0x821 for PHY_N, 0x822 for SRAM_CTL, 0x823 for MINI_MACPHY, 0x824 for ARM_1176, 0x825 for ARM_7TDMI, 0x826 for PHY_LP, 0x827 for PMU, 0x828 for PHY_SSN, 0x829 for SDIO_DEV, 0x82a for ARM_CM3, 0x82b for PHY_HT, 0x82c for MIPS_74K, 0x82d for MAC_GBIT, 0x82e for DDR12_MEM_CTL, 0x82f for PCIE_RC, 0x830 for OCP_OCP_BRIDGE, 0x831 for SHARED_COMMON, 0x832 for OCP_AHB_BRIDGE, 0x833 for SPI_HOST, 0x834 for I2S, 0x835 for SDR_DDR1_MEM_CTL, 0x837 for SHIM, 0x83b for PHY_AC, 0x83c for PCIE2, 0x83d for USB30_DEV, 0x83e for ARM_CR4, 0x840 for GCI, 0x846 for CMEM, 0x847 for ARM_CA7, 0x849 for SYS_MEM and 0xfff for DEFAULT, with at most 16 cores per bus and a 0x1000 byte window per core.

Chip identifiers with BCMA_CHIP_ID_ prefix mix hexadecimal and decimal encodings with 0x4313 for BCM4313, decimal 43142, 43131, 43217, 43222 and 43224 for the matching parts, package codes with BCMA_PKG_ID_ prefix using 0x8 for 43224 CSM fabrication and 0xa for SMIC fabrication, decimal 43225, 43227, 43228, 43421, 43428, 43431 and 43460 for the later parts, plus 0x4331, 0x6362, 0x4360 and 0x4352 for BCM4331, BCM6362, BCM4360 and BCM4352.

Further chip codes with the same prefixes use 0x5300 for BCM4706 with package 1 for the L variant, 0x4716 for BCM4716 with packages 8, 9 and 10 for 4716, 4717 and 4718, decimal 47162, 0x4748, 0x4749, 0x5356 and 0x5357 for 47162, 4748, 4749, 5356 and 5357, package 9 for 5358, package 10 for 47186, package 11 for 5357, decimal 53572 with package 9 for 47188, decimal 53010 for 4707 with packages 1, 2 and 0 for 4707, 4708 and 4709, decimal 53030 for 47094, decimal 53018 for 53018, and decimal 53573 for 53573 with package 0 for 53573 and package 1 for 47189.
Board type codes with BCMA_BOARD_TYPE_ prefix use 0x050f for 94313BU, 0x0510 for 94313HM, 0x0511 for 94313EPA, 0x051c for 94313HMG and 0x04cd for 94716NR2.

Additional board codes with the same prefix use 0x056e for 943224X21, 0x00d1 for its FCC variant, 0x00e9 for the B variant, 0x008b and 0x0090 for M93 and M93A, 0x0093 for X16, and 0x008d plus 0x008e for 94322X9 and 94322M35E.
Further board codes use 0x0540, 0x0541 and 0x0542 for 943228BU8, BU9 and BU, 0x0543 and 0x0544 for 943227HM4L and HMB, and 0x0545 plus 0x0573 for 943228HM4L and 943228SD.

The 94331 family with the same prefix encodes 0x00d6 for X19, 0x00e4 shared by X28 and PCIEBT3AX, 0x010e for X28B, 0x00ec and 0x00ed for X12 2G and 5G, 0x00ef shared by X29B and CSAX, 0x00f5 for X19C, 0x00f4 for X33, 0x0523, 0x0524, 0x0525, 0x0526 and 0x0527 for BU, S9BU, MC, MCI and PCIEBT4, 0x0574 for HM, 0x059b for PCIEDUAL, 0x05a9 for MCH5, 0x05c6 for CS and 0x05da for CD.
Remaining board codes use 0x058d for 953572BU, 0x058e for 953572NR2, 0x058f for 947188NR2, 0x0590 for 953572SDRNR2 and 0x05e0 for 943142HM.

DMA address translation with BCMA_DMA_TRANSLATION_ prefix reserves the top two bits as mask 0xc0000000 with 0x00000000 meaning NONE, 0x40000000 selecting DMA32_CMT client mode for 32-bit DMA and 0x80000000 selecting DMA64_CMT client mode for 64-bit DMA.

ARM control registers with BCMA_DMU_CRU_ prefix place USB2_CONTROL at 0x0164 with NDIV field mask 0x00000ffc shifted by 2 and PDIV field mask 0x00007000 shifted by 12, CLKSET_KEY at 0x0180, and STRAPS_CTRL at 0x02a0 with bit 0x00000010 indicating USB3 and bit 0x00008000 indicating four byte mode.

Chipcommon registers with BCMA_CC_ prefix place identification at offset 0x0000 with identifier mask 0x0000ffff at shift 0, revision mask 0x000f0000 at shift 16, package mask 0x00f00000 at shift 20, core count mask 0x0f000000 at shift 24 and type mask 0xf0000000 at shift 28. Capabilities at 0x0004 report UART count with 0x00000003, big endian MIPS with 0x00000004, UART clock select with 0x00000018 including internal divided clock value 0x00000008, UART on GPIO with 0x00000020, external buses with 0x000000c0, flash type with 0x00000700 where none, ST serial, Atmel serial, NAND and parallel correspond to 0x00000000, 0x00000100, 0x00000200, 0x00000300 and 0x00000700, and PLL type with 0x00038000 where none through type 7 correspond to 0x00000000, 0x00010000, 0x00020000, 0x00030000, 0x00008000, 0x00018000, 0x00028000 and 0x00038000.

Remaining capability bits with the same prefix use 0x00040000 for power control, 0x00380000 for OTP size with shift 19 and base 5, 0x00400000 for JTAG master, 0x00800000 for boot ROM, 0x08000000 for 64-bit backplane, 0x10000000 for PMU, 0x20000000 for ECI, 0x40000000 for SPROM and 0x80000000 for NAND flash. Core control at 0x0008 provides 0x00000001 for UART clock 0, 0x00000002 for sync clock out enable and 0x00000008 for UART clock enable, with built-in self test at 0x000c.

One time programmable status with the same prefix at 0x0010 signals program failure with 0x80000000, protection with 0x00000007 split into hardware 0x00000001, software 0x00000002 and CID 0x00000004 parts, and general use programming indication with 0x00000f00 at shift 8 including hardware region value 0x00000100. Control at 0x0014 carries recovery wait 0xff000000, program wait 0x00ffff00 at shift 8, max failures 0x00000038, voltage select 0x00000006 and select level 0x00000001. Programming at 0x0018 addresses column with 0x000000ff and row with 0x0000ff00 at shift 8, reporting read error 0x10000000, value 0x20000000, read 0x40000000 and start or busy sharing 0x80000000. Layout at 0x001c gives general use offset with 0x00000fff.

Interrupt status with the same prefix at 0x0020 and mask at 0x0024 use 0x00000001 for GPIO, 0x00000002 for external pin and 0x80000000 for watchdog reset. Chip control at 0x0028 and chip status at 0x002c carry per-chip presence bits with 1 and 2 for 4313 SPROM and OTP, 2 and 4 for 4331 SPROM and OTP, 0x00000001, 0x00000002, 0x00000004, 0x00000008, 0x00000010 and 0x00000020 for 43228 ILP divider, OTP, SERDES pad select, SDIO mode, SDIO OTP and SDIO reset, single-bit flags 0 through 3 and 5 for 4706 package option, serial flash presence, flash width, MIPS endian and PCIe1 disable, bit 4 for 5357 NAND boot, and 0x00000001 for 4360 40 MHz crystal.

JTAG command with the same prefix at 0x0030 uses 0x80000000 shared by start and busy plus 0x40000000 for pause, with early access mask 0x0000f000 selecting IRDR, DR, IR, reset, IRPDR and PDR as 0x00000000, 0x00001000, 0x00002000, 0x00003000, 0x00004000 and 0x00005000 and IR width mask 0x00000f00, while later revisions use access mask 0x000f0000 with the same six selections at 0x00000000, 0x00010000, 0x00020000, 0x00030000, 0x00040000 and 0x00050000 plus IR width mask 0x00001f00 at shift 8 and DR width mask 0x0000003f. Instruction, data and control appear at 0x0034, 0x0038 and 0x003c with force clock value 4.

Headers are protected by LINUX_BCMA_DRIVER_ARM_C9_H_ and LINUX_BCMA_DRIVER_CC_H_ include guards and the bcma_bus limits alternate addresses to eight entries, PCI driver state to two slots and total cores to the stated maximum, with PCI-only members valid solely when host type indicates PCI and PCIe generation flag meaningful only in that same case. Additional JTAG control enable symbols and a flash control symbol are named by this dossier part but their numeric encodings fall outside the visible range.

The bcma_mask32, bcma_set32 and related read modify write helpers perform a read followed later by a write with no atomicity or locking visible, so concurrent updates to the same offset can lose bits, and all single and block accesses rely entirely on bus operations for mapping, width handling and ordering with no validation of offset, count or width shown in these wrappers.

The bcma_driver handling moves from probe into an operational phase that may cycle through suspend and resume before ending in removal or shutdown. Command completion for OTP programming and JTAG is indicated with the same encoding used to request start, and JTAG additionally defines a distinct pause encoding.
